headline: Bitcoin is near its weekly low around $74.5k after a week of ETF outflows. Tomorrow's US inflation print (13:30 UK) is the big test, with markets pricing a likely Fed hike in December.
spoken: Cryptonaire brief, Monday evening. Mood: risk-off. Bitcoin is around seventy-four and a half thousand dollars, near its weekly low, after US spot bitcoin funds lost about one point three billion dollars last week. The big one is tomorrow: US inflation at half past one UK time. Markets price roughly an eighty per cent chance the Fed raises rates in December, so a hot number could add pressure. US tech stocks are in a correction. The Bank of England raised rates to four per cent last week. Zcash is steady around twelve hundred and sixty dollars after its NU7 upgrade went live. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips to about $74.5k, weekly low near $73.7k
stories.why: Down from an $81k high on 4 Nov. About $1bn of positions were liquidated in 24h, mostly longs. Daily RSI near 35, close to oversold. Support cited at $71.3k to $67.9k, resistance near $75.6k and $78.2k.
stories.caveat: KuCoin's headline says $10bn liquidated but its own body says about $1bn. The $1bn figure is used here.

stories.title: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.28bn last week (2 to 6 Nov)
stories.why: BlackRock's IBIT accounted for about $1.21bn. ETF buying has been a main source of demand, so steady outflows remove a key bid.

stories.title: US CPI tomorrow 13:30 UK; markets price about 77 to 80% odds of a Fed hike on 9 Dec
stories.why: Consensus is +0.3% m/m headline and +0.2% core (September was +0.6% and +0.3%). No year-on-year figure this month because of the 2025 shutdown data gap. A hot print would firm up hike odds, which has been weighing on bitcoin.

stories.title: Nasdaq in correction, about 12% below its October record after the post-midterm AI sell-off
stories.why: Bitcoin has traded with tech in risk-off spells. VIX closed Friday near 25.5: below 20 would signal calm, above 30 real stress. Oil fell to about $98.

stories.title: Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4.00% (8 to 1, Mann wanted 0.5%)
stories.why: Bailey said it is not necessarily the start of a series, but another rise 'could be fairly strong' if the US–Iran conflict drags on. UK inflation seen near 5% by mid-2027. GBP/USD about 1.347: a stronger pound shrinks the £ value of US$-priced BTC, which matters for UK CGT sums.

stories.title: Zcash NU7 is live: 25-second blocks, 60% of fees held back, old Sprout funds frozen
stories.why: Activated 5 Nov at block 3,543,405. Issuance and the 21m cap are unchanged. About 12,224 ZEC left in the Sprout pool is now unspendable. ZEC about $1,260, roughly flat on the week (+0.8% 7d).

stories.title: Democrats won both chambers on 3 Nov; the CLARITY Act lapses on 3 Jan unless the Senate passes it
stories.why: The US crypto market-structure bill now needs a lame-duck vote. If it lapses, US rules stay unclear for longer, which keeps a regulatory overhang on US-listed crypto.

ahead.what: US bond market closed (Veterans Day); MSCI index review in the evening
